name: Lesson 3 School in the future
unit_name: Unit 3 School: now, then and future
definition: 学习用一般将来时（will）描述未来的学校生活。
key_points: 核心词汇：future 未来, robot 机器人, 3D 三维, e-book 电子书, flying car 飞行汽车, classroom 教室, blackboard 黑板, paper book 纸质书, USA 美国, Canada 加拿大, Australia 澳大利亚, different 不同的, still 仍然
核心句型：Students will have classes in different ways.
Some will have classes at home in 3D classrooms.
They won't read any paper books. They will read e-books.
There will be ...（一般将来时 there be 句型）
语法点：一般将来时 will + 动词原形（肯定、否定、一般疑问句及回答）；will 与 be going to 的初步区别（本单元只涉及 will）；some ... will ... / Some will ... 的用法
common_mistakes: will 后面忘记用动词原形（will goes ❌）
There will be 与 There is/are 时态混淆
won't 是 will not 的缩写容易写成 wont
publisher: 广东教育出版社（粤教沪外教版）
